snippet.title: Mini Mart Survivors | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
You took the night shift at a convenience store to pay off your debt. But the later it gets, the stranger the customers become.

Fend off waves of customers with cup noodles and snacks. Evolve your weapons, make it to the end of your shift, and uncover the secrets Shift24 is hiding at each store!

Start your night shift:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4916560/?l=english
